description: A card revision's description, with its version's measure and fixed values, what it draws against its version with each drawn value's definition, and its selection step, is accepted.

input.title: Gross disbursements to Nigeria for health, 2010 to 2024

values.label: basic health care
values.definition: Basic and primary health care programmes; paramedical and nursing care programmes; supply of drugs, medicines, and vaccines related to basic health care; and activities aimed at achieving universal health coverage.

values.label: health policy and administrative management
values.definition: Health sector policy, planning, and programmes; aid to health ministries and public health administration; institution capacity building and advice; medical insurance programmes; health system strengthening and health governance; and unspecified health activities.

values.label: infectious disease control
values.definition: Immunisation and prevention and control of infectious and parasitic diseases, including diarrhoeal diseases, vector-borne diseases, viral diseases, mycosis, helminthiasis, zoonosis, diseases caused by other bacteria and viruses, and pediculosis. Excludes malaria, tuberculosis, COVID-19, and HIV/AIDS and other sexually transmitted diseases.

input.label: Gross disbursements to Nigeria for health

steps.text: Drew 3 series of gross disbursements to Nigeria for health, 2010 to 2024.

caveats.text: Values of infectious disease control in 2024 are provisional.
